About 
Northwood, a bucolic town in southeastern New Hampshire, was founded in 1773 when its first settlers successfully petitioned the Governor's Council requesting separation from Nottingham. Since this section of Nottingham had been known as the great north woods, the newly formed town was called Northwood. 
Northwood Town Offices are open from 9:00am to 4:00pm Monday, Tuesday & Thursday and 12:00pm to 4:00pm on Wednesday. See Town Clerk/Tax Collector page for hours.

			 Paying Property Taxes 
To pay your property taxes you can drop off a check/money order/certified check in the silver drop box next to the Town Clerk/Tax Collector's door. Please put address or Map/Lot/Sub number on memo line. 
You may also mail payment to Town Clerk/Tax Collector, 818 First NH Turnpike, Northwood, NH 03261. Please put address or Map/Lot/Sub number on memo line. 
https://www.nhtaxkiosk.com/?KI... 
*Credit/Debit Cards accepted on line: Visa, Master Card, Discover & American Express (2.79% fee plus a transaction fee)              *Credit/Debit Cards accepted in our office: Visa, Master Card & Discover ONLY (3% fee) 
			 Register to Vote 
To register to vote for an election, you have two options: 
Register in person at the Town Clerks Office (before deadline announced):  Applicants for registration need  
proof of identity/age (drivers license/photo ID) 
citizenship (birth certificate)  
domicile (utility bill, vehicle registration)  
Register at the polls on Election Day same documents as above examples below. 
Needed: 
Photo ID and birth certificate or Passport. "if your photo ID does not have Northwood as legal residence you will need proof of domicile" 
  If name has been changed: 
Photo ID 
Birth Certificate 
Proof of Name Change "court documents" 
			 How can I obtain an absentee ballot? 
Click the link below for Absentee Ballot information.  Once completed drop off your application in the silver drop-box outside the Town Clerk's office or mail to 818 First New Hampshire Turnpike, Northwood, NH 03261. You may also hand in person during business hours to the clerk. 
 https://www.sos.nh.gov/electio... 
			 How do I license my dog? 
New Hampshire law (RSA 466:1) requires all dogs to be licensed at four months of age. The license renewal period is January 1 through April 30. When you register a dog, you must show proof that the dog has a valid rabies vaccination. 
Register your dog(s) by drop box at the town hall, by mail, in person or you may also license online through the Town Clerk’s website page.   
If submitting payment by mail or drop box, please enclose a copy of the current rabies vaccination information and/or neutering certificate if applicable (this will be sent back to you), a check/money order made payable to the Town of Northwood, mail to:   
Town of Northwood-Town Clerk 
818 First NH Tpke 
Northwood, NH 03261 
Dog License Fees:   
$9.00      for unaltered dogs   
$6.50      for spayed or neutered dogs   
$2.00      for 1st dog only with an owner over 65 (will need owners date of birth "NOT the dog") 
$20.00      for group license of 5 or more dogs  
Dog License  Late  Fees:   
In addition to the license fees provided in RSA 466:4, there shall be a charge of $1.00 for each month if said fees are not paid before June 1 st  in any year. For an example, June 1st- $1.00 late fee in addition to regular fees, July 1st - $2.00 late fee in addition to regular fees, August 1st $3.00 in addition to regular fees and so on. June/July if a dog is not renewed a fine is added $25 on top of registration and late fees. 
Please contact the Town Clerk's office to update our records if you no longer own a dog in order to avoid receiving past due letters and late fees. 
			 How Do I Renew my Registration(s)? 
There are 3 options at this time: Registration and stickers will be mailed to you 
Renew Online through the EB2 Gov website-this will require your routing and account number from checking account:  Online Vehicle Registration 
Mail your renewal notice with a check, money order or certified check to: 
Town of Northwood 
818 First NH Turnpike 
Northwood, NH 03261 
Drop off a check, money order or certified check in the silver drop box which is located next to the Town Clerk’s door.  Please include your renewal notice, copy of your registration(s)s or plate number(s) on memo line, in order for the renewal to be processed.  
			 My license plate(s) is missing or damaged.  How can I get replacement(s)? 
Please fill out the application below and submit it with your original registration.  The cost is $4.00 for one plate or $8.00 for two plates.  This can be done at the Town Clerk’s office or you can mail a check to the DMV and the cost is less: 
Dept. of Motor Vehicles 
23 Hazen Drive 
Concord, NH 03305 
Application For Replacement Plates and/or Decals 
			 How can I obtain replacement decals? 
Submit an Application for  Replacement Plates and/or Decals , along with your current registration. 
The cost is $4.00 at the Town or $1.00 at the Department of Motor Vehicles. 
			 I lost my current registration.  How do I obtain a replacement? 
Submit an  Application for Copy of Registration . 
The cost is $18.00 at the Town or $15.00 at the Department of Motor Vehicles.  
			 I lost my current registration AND decals.  How can I obtain replacement? 
Submit an  Application for Copy of Registration  AND  Application for Replacement Plates and/or Decals . 
The cost is $22.00 at the Town or $16.00 at the Department of Motor Vehicles.  
			 I purchased a used vehicle that’s a 1999 or older, all I have is a Bill of Sale.  What else will I NEED to register my vehicle? 
You either NEED the prior owners registration, certificate of title/origin or a VIN verification form done from the Police Dept. or an Authorized NH Inspection Station (NO exceptions).  WE can not process unless 1 of the above is brought in with your bill of sale and photo ID.  
Please call 603-942-8284 to arrange for an Officer to verify your VIN at your residence. form is below (click on link)  
Verification of Vehicle Identification 
			 I purchased a used trailer and the Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW) is less than 3,001 lbs., what do I need to register it?  
You will need to provide your  photo ID, Bill of Sale  and one of the three options below: 
Certificate of Origin 
VIN Verification Form 
Prior Owners Registration 
Verification of Vehicle Identification 
			 I have lost or misplaced my title. How can I obtain a duplicate? 
Complete an  Application for Duplicate Title  submit it along with a fee of $25.00 to the Department of Motor Vehicles.  Note the Town does not process duplicate titles. 
Department of Motor Vehicles 
25 Hazen Drive 
Concord, NH 03305 
			 How can I obtain Vanity Plates? 
Please complete the  Application for Vanity Plates  in its entirety.  You must also determine if the Vanity Plate of your choice is available prior to meeting with the Town Clerk's office.  The cost is $48.00 for the first year ($40 for vanity and the $8 initial cost of plate) and $40.00 annually thereafter.   
NH Department of Motor Vehicles Vanity Plates Information Page 
			 I recently moved to Northwood, how do I change my address and register my vehicles? 
You must provide your photo ID along with proof of residency to the Town Clerk.  Examples include: 
Copy of deed 
Rental agreement 
Utility bill 
The  Record Change Request  will need to be completed and submitted along with your registration request.  If you do not need to process a registration but you would like to change your address with the DMV, you only need to mail the application to: 
Department of Motor Vehicles 
23 Hazen Drive 
Concord, NH 03305 
			 How do I see my outstanding Property Tax balance? 
The NH Tax Kiosk is a website configured by the Town to provide a method by which you can easily access property tax information on the Internet at any time of day without having to contact the Tax Collector.  Click below to access the NH Tax Kiosk 
New Hampshire Tax Kiosk 
			 How do I apply for a Certified copy of a Birth Certificate, Marriage Certificate or Death Certificate?  
Make your request through the Town's website below.  The Town Clerk's office will mail the certificate to you or you can arrange to pick it up.  You must email the Town Clerk's office a copy of your photo ID.

			 Return check procedure 
FOR YOUR INFORMATION: your check may take several days before it comes back to us for NSF (Non-Sufficient Funds), Unable to Locate, Account Closed etc. 
Your returned/bounced check and documentation from the bank is forwarded to the Finance Director 
Finance will contact customer/resident by mail to make repayment plus a $25.00 penalty fee. PAYMENT CAN ONLY be in a form of a Bank Check, Money Order or Cash 
NO response, a certified letter is sent for repayment *also the certified mailing fee will now be added to previous amount and penalty 
NO response-check/documentation is turned over to the Northwood Police Department for collection
